Mall Arauco Quilicura

Arauco Mall in Quilicura, in the north-western area close to the airport. Offers a full mix of stores, dining and entertainment for local residents and those moving along that corridor.

Best for

  • Quilicura residents
  • North-western area
  • Stop near the airport

Not ideal for

  • Tourists from other areas without a car
  • Those looking for luxury malls

Getting there

No direct metro to the mall. Access by bus or car.

Recommended time: 1–2 hours

Nearby attractions

  • Aeropuerto Arturo Merino Benitez

Tips
